jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare-operations transition role owning practice onboarding and implementation, with provider-practice operations, EHR/data workflows, vendor relationships, care-management platforms and reporting all closely aligned to Kevin’s intake, systems, training and workflow work.
jobs.gap: Nephrology, chronic-care/CMS program experience and direct EHR data-transfer experience are preferred; Kevin should position his Medicaid/ABA operations experience as adjacent rather than equivalent.

jobs.title: Manager, Clinical Operations
jobs.why: Very strong match for healthcare operations, workflow design, process documentation, launch readiness, tooling, vendor coordination, KPI ownership and scaling care-delivery operations in a growth-stage healthcare company.
jobs.gap: Kevin lacks direct oncology/value-based-care experience and should emphasize transferable healthcare operations and systems-building rather than clinical domain expertise.

jobs.title: EHR Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong program/implementation fit involving full lifecycle delivery, stakeholder alignment, roadmaps, risk management, resource coordination and process improvement in healthcare technology.
jobs.gap: The role asks for 5+ years of program/project management and direct EHR implementation depth. Kevin’s systems/project work is relevant, but the EHR and tenure requirements make this a reach.

jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.why: Mental-health operations role centered on daily operational ownership, SOPs, quality assurance, scalable workflows, clinical product-launch readiness, dashboards, vendor management and cross-functional execution—highly relevant to Kevin’s ABA operations background.
jobs.gap: Headway asks for 5+ years in high-growth operational roles and proficiency with data tools including SQL. Kevin should describe SQL only as foundational/working knowledge and lean on Excel/reporting/process strengths.

jobs.title: Manager, Learning & Development
jobs.why: A strong crossover between Kevin’s healthcare operations and BT training work: owning care-team onboarding logistics, translating training frameworks into reusable sessions/templates, measuring effectiveness and enabling new-market launches.
jobs.gap: Kevin has meaningful trainer/onboarding experience but may have less formal enterprise L&D ownership than competing candidates; quantify training volume, curriculum ownership and onboarding outcomes.
